# airlock_application (Resource)

Manage an Airlock allowlist application package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_application" "example" {
  name    = "tf-example-application"
  version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application package name.

### Optional

- `category_id` (String) Application category ID.
- `version` (String) Application package version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Airlock object ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_application.example 1700000000
```
